PresentMon integration notice
=============================

Vigil Overlay uses the standalone PresentMon console collector as an isolated,
on-injected frame-presentation telemetry broker on Windows.

Pinned upstream release: PresentMon v2.5.1
Upstream project: https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon
Runtime file: PresentMon-2.5.1-x64.exe
Expected SHA-256: 9bec3083069f58f911e6a512f4806db51a27bd096103087bc1d05ef54c80a191
License: MIT (see LICENSE.txt in this directory)

The PresentMon executable is supplied with the Vigil distribution under
`vigil_overlay/resources/third_party/presentmon/bin`. Vigil verifies the pinned
SHA-256 before executing the collector. Vigil does not download, replace, or
update PresentMon at runtime.

The upstream v2.5.1 THIRD_PARTY.txt is included in this directory and must be
preserved with distributed copies of the collector.
